**Pre-market brief - Wednesday 2026-11-11**

**Bottom line**

- **The one setup** - CRWV (CoreWeave), the day's engine, is a long on a break of its pre-market high **57.82**; invalidated by a trade back to/below prior close **48.73**.
- **The one risk** - NVDA is the anchor of the whole bid and it is only **+3.86%** pre-market after two down sessions and an independent-director probe into the CEO;
- a loss of prior close **168.89** unwinds the complex, and Nvidia reports Nov 17.
- **The one thing to watch** - NBIS pre-market:
- it reports Q3 on Nov 12 before the open and at **+13.17%** it is the most crowded leg of the neocloud bid, so a second read-through failure removes the trade's foundation.

**8. Macro calendar**

- Tuesday's October CPI was the macro of the last session:
- headline +0.4% month over month against 0.3% expected and core +0.3% against 0.2% expected, which pushed traders back to pricing a Federal Reserve hike.
- **Today (Nov 11) is Veterans Day: US stock markets trade normal hours, and SIFMA recommends a full bond market close.** The BLS calendar carries no US release today.
- The day's noise is the Fed's speaker circuit - Logan, Bowman, Daly, Schmid and Waller appear across the published calendars for Nov 11 and Nov 12 - and the Kansas City Fed publishes its policy-rate skew at noon Central time.
- **Friday Nov 13 at 08:30 ET is the next real catalyst - the October PPI**, with consensus at +0.4% month over month against a +1.3% prior print.
- Rates and the dollar are not easing the setup: the US 10-year sits at 4.983% and the dollar index is up 0.43%.

**11. Open research queue**

- CoreWeave's 2028 adjusted-profitability promise is the load-bearing claim of the whole neocloud bid - track the debt-funded build against the $132.5bn backlog, and watch whether customer prepayments hold at the roughly $9bn level it reported.
- Nebius reports before the open on Nov 12.
- It is the most crowded leg of the theme at +13.17%, and the run rate has to climb toward management's $7-9bn December target.
- Nvidia's fiscal Q3 on Nov 17 lands with the independent-director investigation open.
- The whole AI complex is priced off that print, and the +3.86% pre-market recovery assumes the governance story does not spread.
- Microsoft's tightening oversight of neocloud projects - a Nov 5 Bloomberg report covering Nebius, IREN and Nscale - is the structural risk to the group, not the midterm politics that hit it on Nov 5.
- The Bernstein co-packaged-optics call and the reported Microsoft lobbying against a Chinese optical-transceiver import ban point in opposite directions for the optics names.
- Resolve which one the tape is actually pricing before adding to the group.
